items.label: Plant Support Cage Kit
items.value: You will receive 3 sets large size heavy-duty metal peony cages, each consisting of a wide top grid ring with a diameter of 33cm/13 inch and 4pcs thick supporting legs with a total height of 76cm/30 inch, diameters of 4.6mm and 6mm, providing strong and stable support for plants.

items.label: High Quality Material
items.value: Our cage plant holder is made of thick iron wire, which is sturdy, durable, and not easily bent; The green coating on its surface can effectively prevent rusting and hide it well in plants, without affecting the beauty of the landscape. It is not limited by weather and can be used outdoors for a long time to keep plants growing upright.

items.label: Peony Grid Cages
items.value: Peony support rings have good load-bearing and support capabilities. During the growth period of plants, passing the plant through the ring and gathering them in the support cage can maintain their healthy upright growth; The grid top can support flowers and fruits, ensuring that plant stems are not bent and maintain an elegant growth state at all times.

items.label: Easy to use
items.value: No need for any tools! Firstly, screw the two supporting legs together, then fix the four supporting legs onto the outer ring at the top of the grid ring by twisting them, and finally firmly insert them into the ground. And the detachable design makes storage more convenient and space saving. It's the best choice for garden plant support.

items.label: Widely Used
items.value: Grid support cages are very suitable for indoor and outdoor shrubs, multiple plants, vines, potted plants, etc. Perfect for supporting flowers, vegetables, potted fruit trees, such as peonies, hydrangeas, cornflowers, tomatoes, etc., helping to create beautiful courtyards, gardens, and backyard landscapes.
